message.content: {"caption":"Utility progression over agent iterations, with confidence band and annotated tool or agent modifications.","description":"A line chart with Agent Iteration on the horizontal axis (0–15) and Utility on the vertical axis, with labeled ticks at 0.55, 0.60, 0.65, and 0.70. The blue Mean Utility line fluctuates: it rises early, dips and rebounds through iterations 2–8, jumps near iteration 9, varies around 0.62 through iteration 12, drops at 13, peaks at 14, then falls at 15. The red Best Utility So Far line is a non-decreasing staircase: it rises around iterations 1, 5, 7, 9, and 14, staying flat between rises and ending above the mean. A light-blue shaded 95% Confidence Interval surrounds the mean line. Annotations with arrows mark ‘Smart Edit’ Tool near iteration 1 (arrow down), Code Context Summarization near iteration 5 (arrow up), File Edit Verification near iteration 7 (arrow down), AST Symbol Locator near iteration 9 (arrow down), and Hybrid Symbol Locator near iteration 14 (diagonal arrow down-right).
